A.text: During transcription, mRNA is synthesised from DNA nucleotides to have the same sequence of nucleotides as the DNA strand on which it was made.

B.text: During transcription, tRNA is synthesised from RNA nucleotides and carries codons that are complementary to the sequence of nucleotides on the DNA strand on which it was made.

C.text: During translation, mRNA is synthesised from RNA nucleotides to have the complementary sequence of nucleotides to that of the DNA strand on which it was made.

D.text: During translation, ribosomes join amino acids in a sequence determined by mRNA with the complementary sequence of nucleotides to that of the DNA strand on which it was made.
